def format_shipping_address(shipping):
    name = shipping.get('name', '')
    street = shipping.get('street', '')
    city = shipping.get('city', '')
    postcode = shipping.get('postcode', '')
    name = '' if name is None else str(name)
    street = '' if street is None else str(street)
    city = '' if city is None else str(city)
    postcode = '' if postcode is None else str(postcode)
    return "\n".join([name, street, f"{city} {postcode}".strip()])
fix_rationale: Removed the stray print that referenced billing fields to eliminate side effects, and coerced fields to strings treating None as empty to avoid type errors and ensure consistent output.
